test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 14 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
**Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose ‘No error’.**

Around 30 percent of the Indian population are estimated to have latent TB.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **error in** the sentence lies in the **subject-verb agreement.**
 
• **When we are referring** to a percentage of a population, we usually treat it as singular.
 
• Therefore, the **correct form** of the verb here should be **"is" instead of "are".**

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is:* "Around 30 percent of the Indian population is estimated to have latent TB."*
